findings.text: the recorded reload deferral is built as f"the import probe timed out ({reason})" while reason is itself ImportProbeTimedOut('the import probe timed out after 30 s'), so the watch record's reload_deferral.reason reads "the import probe timed out (the import probe timed out after 30 s)" -- a duplicated clause in the field a reader consumes, where the sibling branch at line 368 passes a phrase naming the condition and lets reason supply the detail.

the timeout branch sets no once-per-contiguous-condition marker, unlike the dirty branch's dirty_deferral flag (line 344) and the failed-import branch's deferred_stamp (line 369); while the code stamp stays moved and the probe keeps running out of its bound under sustained load, the same deferral line is echoed on every poll past runs.FOLLOWER_FRESHNESS_SECONDS and each of those polls spends up to the full probe bound on a subprocess, so a slow node produces an unbounded stream of identical lines.
